statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
The patient has a history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service is intended to correlate symptomatic events with arrhythmic burden and capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
